glas.mask_semantics: 0 = non-gland; positive integers are gland instance IDs

crag.mask_semantics: Verify against provider-approved v2; retain original gland instance IDs

paip2019.mask_semantics: Separate official binary TIF masks for whole tumor and viable tumor; preserve negative pen exclusions

wsss4luad.note: Class 0 is tumor. Only validation masks pass pairing checks in this mirror.

rings-glands.note: Binary manual gland target; no instance IDs or exhaustive stroma annotation.

labels.0: outside tumor mask (not a stroma class)

rings-tumor.note: Separate binary tumor target overlaps the gland target; never merge by class priority.

cocahis-vista.note: Original CoCaHis target is metastatic colon cancer in liver; exact VISTA foreground and annotator aggregation must be reconciled before evaluation.

sicapv2.mask_semantics: Raw JPEG intensities cannot yet be mapped safely to the conceptual codes. Do not threshold or round into classes.

labels.1: automatically detected normal tissue (not expert stroma)

segpath-panck.note: Binary target within its own staining cohort; do not merge targets into a multiclass mask across images.
